by: converted (convert1d) from fact_check__1.json and the research's 3 searches

checks.claim: In 1902 Willis Carrier designed an air conditioning system for a printing plant in Brooklyn
checks.why: The date and the Brooklyn printing plant are supported; 'first modern' is only the company's framing.

checks.claim: Carrier's system was built to control humidity so the paper would not swell and the colours would line up
checks.why: Carrier.com says humidity swings made the paper expand and contract and the colours misalign.

checks.claim: An air conditioner's cold coil pulls water out of the air, which drips into a pan and drains away
checks.why: A drain-pan patent and an HVAC company both describe water collecting on the coil, dripping into a pan and draining away.

sources.title: US6978909B2 - Condensate drain pan for air conditioning system
